bunfig.toml.policy: User-selected values and strict requirements take priority; remaining applicable values use pinned defaults. Empty maps/lists do not invent feature entries.

excluded.origin: No Bun-hosted application or absolute import origin is selected; Vite/SvelteKit own application URLs.
excluded.env.file: env=false explicitly disables Bun dotenv loading; the file-loading variant is incompatible.
excluded.serve.port: The app uses the Vite server. The test-only Bun server supplies loopback port 0 directly and closes after tests.
excluded.serve.static.plugins: Bun static HTML bundling is not used; SvelteKit/Vite build the application.
excluded.serve.static.hmr: Bun static HTML bundling is not used; Vite owns development HMR.
excluded.serve.static.minify: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected.
excluded.serve.static.minify.syntax: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected.
excluded.serve.static.minify.whitespace: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected.
excluded.serve.static.minify.identifiers: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected.
excluded.serve.static.sourcemap: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected.
excluded.serve.static.define: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected.
excluded.serve.static.publicPath: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected.
excluded.serve.static.env: Bun static HTML bundling is not selected; application env injection is disabled.
excluded.bundle.outdir: Bun's bundler is not selected; Vite/SvelteKit and the static adapter own output.
excluded.jsx: No JSX source is authored; Svelte handles templates.
excluded.test.reporter.junit: No CI or JUnit output destination is selected. Text and LCOV reporting are explicit.
excluded.test.reporter.dot: Legacy singular alias; the canonical dots setting is explicit.
excluded.test.coverageThreshold.statements: The pinned Bun documentation states that this key is accepted but not enforced. Required line/function thresholds are explicit and negatively tested.
excluded.test.seed: Random ordering is explicitly disabled. No fixed invented seed is applicable.
excluded.test.concurrentTestGlob: No concurrent test pattern is selected. Pinned Bun rejects an empty array with 'concurrentTestGlob array cannot be empty'; inventing a pattern would change execution.
excluded.install.concurrentScripts: Each named install task explicitly passes max(1,floor(availableParallelism()*0.8)); fixed TOML would violate the approved machine-dependent rule.
excluded.install.cafile: No private certificate authority is selected; use the runtime trust store.
excluded.install.ca: No custom certificate contents are selected; use the runtime trust store.
excluded.install.registry.url: The public npm registry string variant is explicit; an authenticated registry object is not selected.
excluded.install.registry.username: No authenticated registry is selected; do not invent or store credentials.
excluded.install.registry.password: No authenticated registry is selected; do not invent or store credentials.
excluded.install.registry.token: No authenticated registry is selected; do not invent or store credentials.
excluded.install.scopes.*.url: No scoped registries are selected; scopes is explicitly empty.
excluded.install.scopes.*.username: No scoped registries or credentials are selected.
excluded.install.scopes.*.password: No scoped registries or credentials are selected.
excluded.install.scopes.*.token: No scoped registries or credentials are selected.
excluded.install.globalStore: Only applies to isolated installs; the approved single-package hoisted linker is explicit.
excluded.install.globalDir: Project tasks install locally; no global install task is authorised.
excluded.install.globalBinDir: Project tasks install locally; no global executable destination is selected.
excluded.install.security.scanner: No third-party security scanner package is approved or installed.
excluded.install.minimumReleaseAge: Pinned default is null (disabled), which TOML cannot represent. Exact reviewed pins and frozen installs remain required.
excluded.install.publicHoistPattern: Only affects the unselected isolated linker.
excluded.install.hoistPattern: Only affects the unselected isolated linker.
excluded.install.hoist: Only affects the unselected isolated linker. Hoisted installs are unaffected, per pinned docs.

tsconfig.json.policy: User-selected values and strict requirements take priority; remaining applicable values use pinned defaults. Empty maps/lists do not invent feature entries.

excluded.files: Input roots are selected by the explicit include globs; no additional individual file roots are selected.
excluded.watchOptions: No TypeScript watch task is selected; full one-shot checking runs through named tasks.
excluded.compilerOptions exclusions: Every compiler option exclusion is individually listed in config-inventory/TypeScript-*.json. Framework-generated paths/rootDirs are owned by $app/tsconfig.

tsconfig.tools.json.policy: User-selected values and strict requirements take priority; remaining applicable values use pinned defaults. Empty maps/lists do not invent feature entries.

excluded.files: Input roots are selected by the explicit include globs; no additional individual file roots are selected.
excluded.watchOptions: No TypeScript watch task is selected; full one-shot checking runs through named tasks.
excluded.compilerOptions.*: All compiler options inherit tsconfig.json except types, rootDirs and paths, which are explicitly overridden here.
excluded.compilerOptions exclusions: Every compiler option exclusion is individually listed in config-inventory/TypeScript-*.json. Framework-generated paths/rootDirs are owned by $app/tsconfig.

excluded.compilerOptions.types: Worker-only virtual-module declarations mirror consumed pinned exports; the full Kit declaration bundle assumes DOM and is checked by the main DOM project. No library checks are skipped.
